description: Parity cases for crew_status_decide() (20261124060200_crew_vessel_list.sql) and crewStatusDecide() (src/modules/crew/lib/crewStatus.ts). First match wins: on_transfer > pending (planned or pending placement) > on_leave (a day code other than F and T) > ashore (last In/Out event out) > on_board. Day codes are trimmed and upper-cased; an empty code is no code. Every combination below is asserted by src/test/crew/crewStatus.test.ts and by supabase/tests/sql/crew/vessel_list.test.sql.
